column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Playing” is rendered “Rejoicing,” and “the world of his earth” as “the world, His earth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Children” is rendered “sons,” and NASB adds “For.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Listen to” is rendered “Heed,” and “act wisely” as “be wise.”
Close to the Hebrew; “My doors” is rendered “my gates,” and “keeping watch … watching” as “Watching … Waiting.”
Close to the Hebrew; “One who misses me” is rendered “he who sins against me.”
